data.title: Binance Will List Community Coin Vote Round 3 Winner CTXC and Has Distributed Rewards
data.body:
Fellow Binancians,

The third round of the new Community Coin Vote is now complete. Congratulations to the winner, CTXC on having the most votes. We would also like to thank AERGO for their participation.

All users that voted for CTXC will receive an airdrop of 35.32093889 CTXC to their Binance accounts for each vote they cast. For example, if you had cast 10 votes for CTXC, you will receive 353.2093889 CTXC in rewards. 

All users that voted for AERGO will receive an airdrop of 0.20161290 BNB to their Binance accounts for each vote they cast. For example, if you had cast 10 votes for AERGO, you will receive 2.0161290 BNB in rewards.

Distribution of the above airdrop rewards is now complete.

Binance will list Cortex (CTXC) and open trading for CTXC/BNB, CTXC/BTC and CTXC/USDT trading pairs at 2019/11/22 2:00 PM (UTC). Users can now start depositing CTXC in preparation for trading.

Details:

  • About CTXC (CTXC)
  • CTXC Project Research Report
  • Fees
  • Rules

For projects that are interested in participating in future Binance community coin votes, please apply here.

Risk warning: Cryptocurrency trading is subject to high market risk. Please make your trades cautiously. Binance will make best efforts to choose high quality coins, but will not be responsible for your trading losses.

Thanks for your support!

Binance Team

2019/11/22

 

Find us on 

Telegram: https://t.me/binanceexchange

Twitter: https://twitter.com/binance

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/binance 

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/binance
